panels.title: Connection Status
panels.description: Status of every target from every measurement point (source + sub-interface), decided by majority over the last 5 probe rounds (one round about every 60 s). UP = at least 3 of 5 rounds got a reply; DOWN = at least 3 of 5 got none; UNKNOWN = no majority yet (just started, or the probe tool failed in some rounds; failed rounds are neither UP nor DOWN). A target that is UP with 3 of 5 rounds is still UP, but its availability is only 60%. Statuses are hidden when the collector has not completed a round for 180 s (see Last Probe Received).

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Share of the last 5 probe rounds that got a reply, pooled over all selected pairs (total UP rounds / total valid rounds), over time. Rounds where the probe tool failed are not counted. Green = 100%, orange = 50-99%, red = below 50%.

panels.title: UP
panels.description: Pairs (source + sub-interface + target) with at least 3 of the last 5 probe rounds answered.

panels.title: DOWN
panels.description: Pairs with at least 3 of the last 5 probe rounds unanswered.

panels.title: Total
panels.description: All monitored pairs = UP + DOWN + UNKNOWN (pairs without a majority yet).

panels.title: Median Latency (ms)
panels.description: Median round-trip time of each probe round.

panels.title: Jitter (ms)
panels.description: Mean difference between consecutive replies in each probe round.

panels.title: Packet Loss (%)
panels.description: Share of the 20 probe packets of each round that got no reply.

panels.title: Summary per Target
panels.description: Connection quality per target and per measurement point (source + sub-interface) in the selected time range. Status = majority of the last 5 probe rounds in the range (same rule as Connection Status: at least 3 of 5 answered = UP, at least 3 of 5 unanswered = DOWN, otherwise UNKNOWN).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT target_name AS "Target", display_name AS "Source", coalesce(iface, '-') AS "Sub-interface",
       coalesce(source_asn, '') AS "ASN",
       round((percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY median_ms))::numeric, 1) AS "Median (ms)",
       round(avg(jitter_ms)::numeric, 1) AS "Jitter (ms)",
       round(avg(loss_pct)::numeric, 1) AS "Loss (%)",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'DOWN') AS "Down Count",
       count(*) AS "Samples",
       CASE WHEN cardinality(array_positions((array_agg(status ORDER BY ts DESC))[1:5], 'UP')) >= 3 THEN 'UP'
            WHEN cardinality(array_positions((array_agg(status ORDER BY ts DESC))[1:5], 'DOWN')) >= 3 THEN 'DOWN'
            ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS "Status"
FROM v_probe
WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND source_type ~ '^${stype:regex}$' AND coalesce(iface, '') ~ '^${iface:regex}$' AND target_ip ~ '^${target:regex}$'
GROUP BY target_name, display_name, iface, source_asn
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Latest Trace per Pair
panels.description: Latest trace of every pair (target + source + sub-interface) in the last 24 hours, one block of hops per pair. Narrow it down with the Target and Sub-interface filters at the top.

targets.rawSql:
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (target_ip, source_key, coalesce(iface, '')) id, ts, display_name, target_ip
  FROM v_trace
  WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 day' AND target_ip ~ '^${target:regex}$' AND source_type ~ '^${stype:regex}$' AND coalesce(iface, '') ~ '^${iface:regex}$'
  ORDER BY target_ip, source_key, coalesce(iface, ''), ts DESC
)
SELECT coalesce(t.name, l.target_ip) AS "Target", l.display_name AS "Source", l.ts AS "Time", h.hop AS "Hop",
       coalesce(h.ip, '*') AS "IP Address", h.loss_pct AS "Loss (%)", h.median_ms AS "RTT (ms)",
       coalesce(h.country, '') AS "Country", coalesce(h.asn, '') AS "ASN", coalesce(h.org, '') AS "Organization"
FROM latest l JOIN trace_hop h ON h.run_id = l.id
LEFT JOIN target t ON t.ip = l.target_ip
ORDER BY 1, 2, h.hop

panels.title: Route and Packet-loss History
panels.description: Packet loss per target over time (worst sub-interface). Green = no loss, yellow = minor (up to 5%, 1 of 20 packets), orange = high (6-20%), red = severe (above 20%), empty = no data.

panels.title: Recent Alerts
panels.description: Telegram alerts sent in the last 7 days (table alert_event).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT a.ts AS "Time", coalesce(t.name, a.target_ip, '-') AS "Target",
       coalesce(s.display || coalesce(' · ' || a.iface, ''), a.iface, '-') AS "Source",
       CASE WHEN a.state = 'recover' THEN 'Recovered'
            WHEN a.kind = 'route' THEN 'Route Change'
            WHEN a.kind = 'path' THEN 'Path Issue'
            WHEN a.kind = 'probe-error' THEN 'Probe Error'
            WHEN a.kind = 'stale' THEN 'Data Stale'
            WHEN a.kind = 'no-subif' THEN 'No Sub-interface'
            WHEN a.status = 'DOWN' THEN 'Target Down'
            WHEN a.status = 'UNSTABLE' THEN 'Unstable'
            WHEN a.status = 'DEGRADED' THEN 'Degraded'
            ELSE initcap(a.kind) END AS "Event",
       CASE WHEN a.state = 'recover' THEN 'Back to normal'
            WHEN a.kind = 'route' THEN 'AS path changed and stayed changed'
            WHEN a.kind = 'path' THEN 'Many targets affected on one sub-interface'
            WHEN a.kind = 'probe-error' THEN 'fping failed; targets not counted as down'
            WHEN a.kind = 'stale' THEN 'No new measurements in PostgreSQL'
            WHEN a.kind = 'no-subif' THEN 'No active sub-interface'
            WHEN a.status = 'DOWN' THEN 'No reply to any probe'
            ELSE 'Latency / jitter / loss outside the usual range' END
         || coalesce(' (' || a.severity || ')', '') AS "Details"
FROM alert_event a
LEFT JOIN target t ON t.ip = a.target_ip
LEFT JOIN source s ON s.name = a.source
WHERE a.ts > now() - interval '7 days' AND coalesce(a.iface, '') ~ '^${iface:regex}$'
ORDER BY a.ts DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Last Probe Received
panels.description: Time of the latest measurement stored in PostgreSQL for each target and measurement point. Delay above 180 s means no new data (the freshness job sends a Telegram alert).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT target_name AS "Target", display_name AS "Source", coalesce(iface, '-') AS "Sub-interface",
       max(ts) AS "Last Probe", round(extract(epoch FROM now() - max(ts)))::int AS "Delay"
FROM v_probe
WHERE ts > now() - interval '1 day' AND source_type ~ '^${stype:regex}$' AND coalesce(iface, '') ~ '^${iface:regex}$' AND target_ip ~ '^${target:regex}$'
GROUP BY target_name, display_name, iface
ORDER BY 5 DESC, 1

panels.title: Hop Count
panels.description: Number of hops in the latest trace to each selected target (highest value among the selected sub-interfaces; they share the same Wi-Fi and ISP, so the hop count is normally the same). Pick one sub-interface at the top to see it alone.

panels.title: Suspected Loss Start Hop
panels.description: Pairs whose latest trace shows real packet loss, with the hop number where the loss starts (the loss continues to the destination). None = no selected pair has real loss. Hops that only rate-limit ICMP replies are not counted.

panels.title: Median Latency History (7 days)
panels.description: Hourly median latency to each selected target over the last 7 days (median over the selected sub-interfaces; table probe_hourly, filled by the hourly rollup job). Pick one sub-interface at the top to see it alone.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.hour AS "time", coalesce(t.name, h.target_ip) AS metric,
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY h.median_ms) AS value
FROM probe_hourly h LEFT JOIN target t ON t.ip = h.target_ip
WHERE $__timeFilter(h.hour) AND h.target_ip ~ '^${target:regex}$' AND h.iface ~ '^${iface:regex}$'
  AND (CASE WHEN h.source LIKE 'gp/%' THEN 'Globalping' ELSE 'Local' END) ~ '^${stype:regex}$'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Detailed Hop History (24 hours)
panels.description: Every hop of every trace to the selected targets in the last 24 hours, newest first (at most 500 rows; narrow it down with the Target filter).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT r.ts AS "Time", coalesce(t.name, r.target_ip) AS "Target", r.display_name AS "Source", h.hop AS "Hop",
       coalesce(h.ip, '*') AS "IP Address", h.loss_pct AS "Loss (%)", h.median_ms AS "RTT (ms)",
       coalesce(h.asn, '') AS "ASN", coalesce(h.org, '') AS "Organization"
FROM v_trace r JOIN trace_hop h ON h.run_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN target t ON t.ip = r.target_ip
WHERE $__timeFilter(r.ts) AND r.target_ip ~ '^${target:regex}$'
  AND r.source_type ~ '^${stype:regex}$' AND coalesce(r.iface, '') ~ '^${iface:regex}$'
ORDER BY r.ts DESC, 2, h.hop
LIMIT 500
